name: ppk2-saleae-shared-signal-long
experiment:
name: ppk2-saleae-shared-signal-long
duration: 12s

devices:
  ppk2:
    plugin: ppk2
    requires: [PowerMeasurement, DigitalCapture]
    mode: source
    supply_mv: 3300
  logic:
    plugin: saleae
    device: SALEAE-FIXTURE
    requires: [DigitalCapture]
    digital_channels: [0]
    digital_sample_rate: 4000000
    channel_names:
      "0": SHARED
  dbg:
    plugin: jlink
    target: NRF52840_XXAA

steps:
  - {name: stretch, at: 2s, device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.write, args: {address: "0x4001B540", data: "401f0000"}}
  - {name: restore, at: 5s, device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.write, args: {address: "0x4001B540", data: "88130000"}}
  - {name: clear, at: 5500ms, device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.write, args: {address: "0x4001B00C", data: "01000000"}}
  - {name: stretch-end, at: 8s, device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.write, args: {address: "0x4001B540", data: "401f0000"}}
  - {name: restore-end, at: 10s, device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.write, args: {address: "0x4001B540", data: "88130000"}}
  - {name: clear-end, at: 10500ms, device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.write, args: {address: "0x4001B00C", data: "01000000"}}

plots:
  - name: overview
    title: Shared DK signal on PPK2 D0 and Saleae CH0
    format: svg

clock.source: sample count x 10 us from the host time of the AVERAGE_START write
clock.note: the PPK2 has no per-sample timestamps; the start of sampling is bounded by the write time (late side) and by data arrival (early side), assuming the device clock does not drift over the first 2 s; later drift is not measured

clock.source: Logic 2 capture time offset, anchored at host time of StartCapture RPC return
clock.note: Logic 2 buffers the capture and returns it after it ends; sample times are offsets from Logic 2's capture start, anchored at the host time the StartCapture RPC returned (RPC latency 444ms). The delay between that RPC and the device actually sampling is not measured, so no error bound is claimed.

clock.source: host clock at RTT telnet receive (target writes are polled by the probe)
clock.note: the stamp is late by the unknown probe polling + USB + TCP latency and never early; lines are not stamped by the target; 3 lines, 112 bytes

clock_calibrations.note: uncertainty = worst residual + half of each timestamp resolution; common-mode delays and probe-point skew are not observable
